description: The linked user's own Goldman Sacks AI trading agent: autonomy level, venue permissions and caps, vault, strategies (status, mirror settings, performance), playbook files, brain settings, recent activity, pending proposals and pending confirmations. Pass playbookFile to read one playbook in full, or mirrorLeader to preview copying a Hyperliquid trader. Read-only: to change anything use swop_update_my_agent; to chat use swop_message_my_agent.

mirrorLeader.description: A Hyperliquid 0x address to preview: the leader's book and the orders the vault would place

playbookFile.description: A playbook file name from playbookFiles, e.g. "strategy.md", to return its full markdown

name: swop_get_my_agent
title: See my Goldman agent
